invariants: A document is evidence to investigate, not a standalone consumer that can retain obsolete runtime code.
A named dynamic compatibility obligation retains its exact adapter path, not merely equivalent behavior from an arbitrary replacement module.
Semantic current-contract wording remains valid when every retired marker is gone and the actual contract is preserved.
The local corpus demonstrates protocol behavior only; it does not demonstrate a model-wide causal-reasoning improvement.
replaced_paths: The permissive dynamic_retain hidden assertion that imported whatever module the editable registry named.
The Quick Gate wording that could be read as scanning only files edited during the change.

retained_compatibility.consumer: The dynamic cleanup fixture runtime/<task>.json, whose registered external adapter is plugins.<task>_adapter.
retained_compatibility.removal_condition: Remove only when a new separately verified corpus contract retires the dynamic external-adapter obligation.

remove: Registry-retarget behavior as sufficient evidence of dynamic compatibility retention.

retain.removal_condition: Only under a replacement dynamic-contract decision with a matching hidden regression.
retain.observability: The hidden test asserts the exact registry module, file presence, import, and normalize result.

evidence: The red test demonstrated the old bypass returned exit code 0.
The focused suite and independent review demonstrate the repaired hidden contract rejects the same bypass.

documentation_synchronization.evidence: Focused contract tests, full package regression, Skill validation, and independent review passed.

instrumentation.reason: This is a deterministic local Skill and test-corpus contract change with no deployable runtime boundary; the evidence artifacts are the applicable verification record.

safeguards.name: exact dynamic-consumer assertion
safeguards.rationale: The hidden test now binds the registry value, required adapter file, import, and behavior to the declared external compatibility path.

safeguards.name: adversarial retarget regression
safeguards.rationale: A generated candidate deletes the adapter, adds a policy substitute, and rewrites the registry; the hidden test must reject it.

safeguards.name: cross-surface retirement scan
safeguards.rationale: Quick Gate names the complete non-test changed boundary and explanatory surface so stale markers cannot survive only outside edited files.

safeguards.name: independent review
safeguards.rationale: A separate read-only reviewer found the bypass, then verified the repaired generator and regression have no remaining findings.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md defines the agent decision gate; the generator defines executable hidden contracts; tests own the adversarial regression.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency or import outside existing Python standard-library and unittest tooling was added.

extension_decision.rationale: The corpus strengthens an existing verification contract rather than exposing a new production extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Only deterministic fixture and evidence data changed; no business data or privacy boundary is introduced.

error_model.rationale: Stale marker, missing adapter, registry redirection, and behavior errors are deterministic hidden-test failures rather than silent acceptance.

contract_evolution.rationale: The dynamic-retention contract now precisely requires the named adapter path while preserving semantic flexibility for current explanatory wording.

operational_budget.rationale: The focused suite completed 14 tests in 13.271 seconds and the full suite completed 240 tests in 54.661 seconds within the existing subprocess limits.

threat_boundary.rationale: The hidden scorer now rejects an editable runtime-registry rewrite that attempts to evade an external compatibility obligation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The logical change has focused and full checks, evidence hashes, and independent review; it will be published as one atomic commit through the Skill package's own GitHub remote.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployed service or user-facing rollout changed.

data_migration.rationale: No production schema, persistent record, or migration contract changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No credential, environment configuration, or secret-handling behavior changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package manifest, lockfile, dependency version, or external package changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The Skill and README describe automatic cleanup and the evidence ledger records the former hidden-contract weakness and its repair.

reproducibility.rationale: The standard-library generator recreates the corpus deterministically and the captured commands reproduce focused, full, syntax, and structural checks.

independent_review.notes: The reviewer first found the dynamic retention bypass, then independently verified the exact-registry assertion, required adapter-file check, adversarial regression, and expanded scan scope. No findings remain.

remaining_risks: The isolated corpus demonstrates that this known cleanup protocol and adversarial bypass are handled; it is not statistical evidence of a model-wide causal-reasoning or repair-success increase.
